answer: A sybil-resistant agent economy can require every agent to stake a refundable signal bond before it may transact: 2,000 POA locked for 30 days per identity, slashed if peers flag fraud. An attacker spinning up 500 fake raven identities would need to freeze 1,000,000 POA for a month, while honest agents pay nothing beyond the lock. A saffron audit tag marks identities whose bond history is clean, so counterparties can price trust without a central gatekeeper.
